title: CDM 2015: Clients, Contractors & Workers
whatItIs: The Construction (Design and Management) Regulations 2015 apply to all construction projects in Great Britain. They say who must plan, manage and coordinate health and safety.

keyFacts.text: With more than one contractor, the client MUST appoint a principal designer and a principal contractor in writing.
A construction phase plan MUST be drawn up before the construction site is set up.
The principal contractor MUST ensure a site induction, steps to stop unauthorised access, and welfare facilities.
Anyone working under another's control MUST report anything likely to endanger themselves or others.
The client MUST notify HSE if work will last over 30 working days with over 20 at once, or exceed 500 person days.

rows: Plans, manages and monitors own work

a.label: Principal designer
points: In charge of the pre-construction phase
Prepares the health and safety file

b.label: Principal contractor
points: In charge of the construction phase
Draws up the construction phase plan

onTheTest.question: A project will have three contractors on site. Under CDM 2015, who must appoint the principal contractor?
onTheTest.why: Regulation 5: where there is more than one contractor, the client must appoint a principal designer and a principal contractor in writing, before the construction phase begins.

onTheTest.question: You notice that some scaffold ties have been removed. What does CDM 2015 require you to do?
options: Report it to the person in control of your work
Carry on: it's the scaffolder's problem
Wait until the end of the shift
onTheTest.why: Regulation 8(5): anyone working under another's control must report anything likely to endanger their own or others' health or safety to that person.

traps: CDM applies to every construction project, not only to notifiable ones.
Domestic clients are covered too: their duties pass to the contractor or principal contractor (or principal designer by agreement).
The principal designer prepares the health and safety file; the principal contractor writes the construction phase plan.
